label: Some concrete being is foundational at w
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation: some concrete candidate is foundational at w: it exists at w, its represented esse equals its represented essence, it has no matter and form, its esse is received in no principle, it is first in SIMPLY_PRIOR_1, nothing is a CAUSE_2 of its esse, it is incorruptible simply and no being has POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over it. Non-modal: it says nothing about the being at other worlds. Admissible on both classical theism and the brute-first rival (controls: theist; bruteFoundational, a contingent such being); the models show admissibility only; a pure Humean who rejects simplicity or act need not accept it.
